handoffs.note: Contained the only real prepared CP-Math backend without revising frozen generic interfaces. CusparseBellBackend now rejects any padded row or feature domain before context initialization or descriptor creation because v1 dense bindings expose no allocation capacities; prepared BELL state snapshots operation metadata and bindings and rejects stale structure, execution order, pointer/identity bindings, or physical geometry/materialization before vendor launch. CP-Math BELL source is explicitly experimental and DeviceMathContext is not presented as an external/Baseplane ABI. Tests cover 9x13 BELL8, 17x31 BELL16, and 33x65 BELL32 padded cases, device guard regions, stale structure/order/binding/geometry, and unsupported numeric combinations. Evidence: host operation contract passed; direct CUDA 12.9 nvcc sm_70 builds passed; cpMathRuntimeTest passed; cpMathCusparseBellTest passed repeatedly on leased V100 gpu:0; CUDA 12.9 compute-sanitizer memcheck of --padded-rejection-only exited 0 with ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors. Full aligned BELL under sanitizer separately exposed an existing BELL8 column-major numerical mismatch while reporting zero memory errors; ordinary runs pass, no BELL repair was attempted, and the path remains quarantined experimental evidence. No CMake, Baseplane, CellShard, benchmark, or public frozen interface file changed.

handoffs.note: Implemented deterministic sm_70 FP32 segment sum/maximum over explicit values, segment, and dense axes with independently host-validated offsets, empty sum +0, empty max -infinity, singleton identity, caller stream, explicit zero-scratch caller workspace contract, and no allocation/synchronization. Runtime rejects stale axes, shape/residency/stream mismatch, non-FP32 policy, malformed partitions, and oversized grids. Dominant expected limiter is HBM traffic. Validation: focused sm_70 CUDA test; Compute Sanitizer memcheck 0 errors; diff check.

handoffs.note: Implemented CSG1 semantic geometry persistence in include/Cellerator/geometry/persistence/semantic_geometry_image_v1.hh, src/geometry/persistence/semantic_geometry_image_v1.cc, and tests/geometry/ce_geo/csg1_test.cc. The image is fixed-width little-endian, 64-byte-aligned, sectioned and pointer-free; mandatory work/layout/cover sections plus opaque optional extensions are independently checksummed. Whole-image checksum and a two-word derived geometry identity cover serialized semantics. Validation proves directory bounds/alignment/uniqueness, checksums, exact permutations and exact logical-edge ownership using caller workspace. Relocation resolves from the new base and rejects corrupt or non-identical same-sized storage by checking CSG1 header, whole-image checksum, and recomputed geometry identity. Exact validations passed: g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Iinclude src/geometry/compiler/work_layout.cc src/geometry/compiler/relation_cover.cc src/geometry/persistence/semantic_geometry_image_v1.cc tests/geometry/ce_geo/csg1_test.cc -o /tmp/cellerator_ce_geo_csg1_test && /tmp/cellerator_ce_geo_csg1_test; g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Iinclude src/geometry/compiler/work_layout.cc src/geometry/compiler/relation_cover.cc src/geometry/persistence/semantic_geometry_image_v1.cc tests/geometry/ce_geo/csg1_test.cc -o /tmp/cellerator_ce_geo_csg1_test_san && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 /tmp/cellerator_ce_geo_csg1_test_san; both output csg1_test: ok. git diff --check passed. handoffs.note: Committed b07297100e73e9804e5c8ca4a21d5906cfbfc5c1. Replaced frozen_packing_plan's six independent unique_ptr arrays with one 64-byte-aligned, six-section CPI1 pointer-free image backed by one memory::allocation record; added versioned header validation, canonical geometry identity recomputation, typed host validation, and address-only equal-size rebind suitable for device bases. Existing hot packing_plan_view remains raw-pointer direct and CPK1/CPE2 schemas were not modified. Validation: Release CUDA 12.9.86 sm_70 build; cellPackOptimizerTest passed; cellPackPersistentPackingPayloadTest passed (CPK1 compatibility/canonical recovery); cellPackExecutionImageV2Test passed (1664 bytes, 2 projections); cellPackExecutionImageV2DeviceTest passed (1 upload, 1 hot read); Compute Sanitizer memcheck on device test reported 0 errors; focused CPI1 validate/copy/rebind/validate round trip passed (780-byte 4-feature fixture, 6 sections); git diff --check clean. The first temporary round-trip fixture was correctly rejected because its supplied feature_to_block mapping was invalid; after correcting that test-only mapping the exact round trip passed. No CE-GEO-owned path was changed and no performance speedup is claimed.

No live blocker remains.

handoffs.note: Implemented CE-PTR-13 at actual lane commit 08ae74f9ff5201cc8139cc7053bf82245f42f33f. CE-PTR-06 proposal/refinement/rollback scratch no longer owns ten std::vectors: one exact 64-byte-aligned prepared host slab is sliced into bounded non-owning typed relation views, with preflight overflow/capacity checks and no mutation-time growth/reallocation. The permanent non-strict source gate passes without changing ceilings. Wired device_descriptor and all CE-PTR memory implementation files into Cellerator::runtime; added normal CMake targets for host/session memory contracts, executable/training programs, graph-capture concurrency, and persisted replay. Removed the stale CellShard::runtime link from forward_neighbors and documented its caller-owned prepared-view/downstream-construction boundary. Preserved host_buffer, shared-owned device_buffer, and growable scratch compatibility helpers because reinventory found live production/example/adapter consumers; deletion would violate the no-deletion-with-live-consumers contract, so CE-PTR-15 must retain their documented transitional disposition rather than claim retirement. Validation: Release configure on CUDA 12.9.86, Tesla V100 sm_70; full cmake --build build-ce-ptr-integration -j "$(nproc)" PASS. PASS: cellPackOptimizerTest; celleratorMemoryContractTest; celleratorSessionMemoryTest; celleratorExecutionSessionTest (64 persistent slots, transient 6144 bytes, 2 launch binds); celleratorValueReadinessTest; celleratorExecutableProgramTest; celleratorTrainingProgramTest; celleratorCeLiveConcurrencyTest (sealed allocation/sync invariants and CUDA Graph capture/replay); celleratorCeLiveProgramReplayTest (CPE2/CPEXEC01 typed activation/planner/quantitative CUDA); forward-neighbor target rebuild without CellShard runtime. Permanent source gate: python3 scripts/check_no_inappropriate_core_stl.py PASS. Mutex-protected cellPackOptimizerBench PASS: 5000 features, 4096 sampled rows, 320000 evaluator nnz, objective 320000 to 301340, 38 oracle evaluations, total 1434.04 ms, peak additional optimizer bytes 8925258. Compute Sanitizer could not run because libsanitizer-collection.so is unavailable; no sanitizer result is claimed. git diff --check PASS and worktree clean.

Added explicit memory-substrate device views, support resident binding/launch, exact candidate preflight with all CUB scratch queries, caller-owned reusable workspace, resident canonical pair output, allocation-free exact scoring, POD launch evidence, and explicit terminal host adapters. Legacy host referees preserved. Nsight Compute 12.9 realistic 105000-block score: 4.03 ms, 74.07 GB/s, 74 registers/thread, 37.5% theoretical and 21.92% achieved occupancy; long scoreboard 6.1 cycles / 53.1% of issue interval. Prepared pipeline uses four scalar control synchronizations (nonempty, bucket, raw-pair, unique/evidence counts), none used to size allocation; all capacities are preflighted. Worktree clean.

invariants.rule: Custom CUDA promotion requires reference correctness, relevant Compute Sanitizer tools, robust median/spread timing, profiler evidence, and a repeatable caller-visible win; evaluated_not_promoted is success when the experiment is sound.
CellShard remains an opaque storage, transport, placement, and residency layer and does not interpret Cellerator execution-image tile grammar.

CE-ARCH-70 hardens existing execution foundations only: no new kernel family, projection family, distributed subsystem, generic graph or tensor framework, training path, Tensor Core path, or CellShard placement implementation.
Preserve unrelated dirty work, especially the local Baseplane predicate-plan implementation; do not reset, clean, stash, overwrite, or attribute it without an ownership audit.
Prepared state owns no ordinary launch pointers; launch binding performs no allocation, device discovery, synchronization, or cold execution-image directory parsing.
Preserve CP-BP v1 and CPK1 as compatibility evidence; keep CP-Math v1 isolated as retired evidence and do not resurrect its runtime, backend, BELL, workspace, or planner ownership.

Cellerator owns execution semantics, projections, planning, and kernels; Baseplane owns sequence primitives; CellShard owns opaque persistence, placement, and transport and never interprets Cellerator tile grammar.

Semantic structure, physical projections, mutable value generations, prepared state, launch bindings, streams, and transient workspace retain distinct identities and lifetimes; pointer identity is never semantic identity.
No projection, kernel, hierarchy, fusion, or planner policy is promoted without independent correctness and end-to-end evidence in its declared regime; conventional fallbacks remain available.

Bootstrap adds CE-EXOP and revises only the explicitly authorized CE-AMP prerequisites.
Every CE-AMP task requires CE-EXOP-COMPLETE in addition to explicit human permission.
Cellerator exposes generic partition, order, and resource metadata without importing CellShard or owning distributed placement.
No extensive dataset search or download is part of CE-EXOP.
Projection-primary gradients need not canonicalize before update.
Implemented behavior updates the authoritative documentation spine without creating a competing architecture.
Dynamic gates over stable support do not masquerade as topology changes.
Experimental candidates are explicitly requestable and distinguishable, not hidden in benchmark-only source.
First-class Codex agents own lanes; local workers are subordinate children only.
Every fused path preserves profiler-visible unfused components.
CE-EXOP consumes completed CE-GEO and CE-PTR architecture rather than recreating either campaign.
Global biological IDs and aggregate counts are 64-bit; local physical indices remain compact where valid.
Every relation-algebra primitive remains independently callable and planner-visible.
Very large relations use exact local components or chunks with recoverable global identity.
Implementation lanes own exact files or narrow modules; shared manifests are integration-owned.
Sparse exchange remains a composition of relation operations, not a public attention abstraction.
No biological edge is deleted to satisfy hardware structure.
Scientific kernels do not silently inherit global approximate math policy.

Disabled profiling adds no kernel counters, dynamic strings, allocation, hardware discovery, or stage search to the hot path.

All relation-algebra operations have real operation-core v2 semantics and no rejected placeholder enum values.

No preprint-grade performance claim is required or implied by CE-EXOP.

Mechanism, resource, and stage metadata are constructed before execution.
The complete Cellerator plus CellShard Nsight campaign remains an explicit follow-up.
Program v2 is the sole internal production execution engine.
Projection-primary trainable values preserve exact logical identity and shared generation semantics.
Compiled provider inclusion, detected hardware, and tuning policy are separate.
Every MMA-capable operation retains a complete legal sparse path.
Portable biological geometry remains separate from target-specific physical cover and projection.
Every local logical edge has exactly one semantic owner and one physical contributing owner.
Distinct candidate mechanisms have distinct stable IDs and human-readable kernel and stage names.
Any retained v1 entry is a compatibility wrapper, not a second production engine.
Implement broad differentiated Volta access while deferring exhaustive Nsight-driven microtuning.

Shape never establishes biological equivalence; domain, order, geometry, partition, structure identity and epoch, and value generation remain explicit.

CSG1 contains no architecture, device, provider-kernel, matrix-instruction, pointer, stream, runtime-handle, or mutable-generation identity.
Full physical reorder and regroup freedom is the cheap default unless explicit cold caller constraints restrict it.
Behavior changes update the existing authoritative documentation spine and do not create a competing architecture.
Internal packed order may persist across compatible operations; canonicalization is explicit, justified, and costed.
One versioned data-only semantic strategy boundary is the sole future optimizer extension point; no second optimizer API or frozen binary plugin ABI is introduced.
CellShard, BioPrep, Baseplane, and adapters use only public generic Cellerator contracts and receive no privileged internal access.
Cellerator provides reusable biological operations while GlassHelix owns model architecture, loss, training behavior, latent semantics, and dynamical theory.

New MMA and fusion candidates are empirical-required and cannot enter automatic normal-catalog promotion without clean complete-cost evidence.
Parallel tasks own exact files or narrow modules; shared manifests, registries, exports, and docs belong only to designated integration or documentation tasks.

No biological edge is removed to satisfy structured sparsity or accelerator convenience.
New scientific provider kernels do not silently inherit global fast-math, cache-policy, register-cap, or launch-bound flags.

New CE-GEO production APIs and implementations avoid STL ownership and allocator-heavy container graphs.

Operand conversion, storage, accumulation, output, determinism, rounding, approximation, NaN and Inf behavior are explicit candidate policies.
Production sm_70 MMA owns output rectangles, accumulates through K, stores once, and uses no per-tile output atomics.
Physical padding has no biological identity and is never a logical work item or edge.
The existing end-to-end planner remains the sole final candidate-selection authority.
Never reset, clean, stash, overwrite, delete, silently attribute, or discard user or sibling-agent work.
Hardware and provider discovery, selection, manifest inspection, and projection activation occur before preparation and never in hot kernels.
Capability records advertise implemented source-linked code, not documented but unimplemented ISA features.
A complete exact pure-sparse candidate remains available for every MMA-evaluated operation.
Portable semantic geometry is distinct from device-specific physical projection bytes, padding, and schedules.
CE-GEO neither duplicates, certifies, nor blocks on CE-PTR; it revalidates shared interfaces after concurrent changes.
Immutable topology and mutable values retain independent identities, lifetimes, storage, and invalidation.
Every logical edge has exactly one semantic owner and exactly one physical contributing owner.
All feasible sm_70 foundation, implementation, validation, and evidence work completes before CE-AMP may begin.
Cellerator rearranges work only within the caller-supplied axis-qualified work window.
The Cellerator execution image is a versioned pointer-free relocatable IR with a projection directory; CPK1 v1 and CellShard CPEXEC01 compatibility remain explicit.
Boolean sequence logic, masks, events, segments, identities, and integer counts remain natural representations until a quantitative interaction; planning may choose materialization or fusion.
Immutable structure, semantic geometry, physical projections, mutable value planes, reusable prepared state, and per-launch bindings have separate identities and lifetimes.
Baseplane remains a separate sequence-engineering repository. CE-LIVE may consume its frozen interfaces but may not duplicate or relocate its general execution engine.
CPE2 remains pointer-free persistent execution IR. Typed activation is non-owning. CellShard transports opaque bytes and never selects kernels or interprets Cellerator projection semantics.
Correctness and adversarial validation precede timing. Kernel-only timing is not sufficient for promotion.
The quantitative PBMC3K fixture is for computational correctness and performance only. Missing biological provenance must remain visible and no scientific interpretation may be inferred.
Shape never establishes biological compatibility. Domain, exact order, geometry, partition, structure identity and epoch, and value generation remain explicit.

Forward CP-BP relations use feature-or-gene source and row-or-cell destination. Transpose/backward shares logical edge identity and uses explicit orientation metadata.
Every source mutation occurs under a claimed task with a matching exclusive scope. Integration files are modified only by designated fan-in tasks.
Candidate selection uses complete cost, expected reuse, independent correctness, and a strong conventional fallback. Analytical models shortlist; empirical evidence decides uncertain cases.
Steady-state execution performs no hidden allocation, device selection, descriptor creation, structural hashing, host round trip, or device-wide synchronization.

CelleraTorch never becomes the canonical allocator, parameter owner, planner, runtime, or implementation home for reusable Cellerator math.

This recovery revision changes only todo-orchestrator planning state; CellShard, implementation, CMake, tests, benchmarks, runtime behavior, Git pointers, commits, pushes, claims, and resource leases remain untouched.

Every material migration records the accidental representation, semantic structure, lifetime, bounds, memory domain, mutation pattern, final replacement, invariants, allocation behavior, validation, and performance evidence. Baseplane remains sequence engineering, CellShard remains persistence and delivery, GlassHelix remains scientific dynamics, and CelleraTorch remains optional framework adaptation. No speculative GlassHelix contract is frozen.

After an execution failure that may have partially written output, do not silently retry another backend.

PackingPlan contains durable data-derived structure only; PhysicalExecutionViews are derived; MathRequest has mathematics but no backend; ExecutionPlan is immutable pointer-free metadata; PreparedExecution owns live CUDA state.
Repeated PreparedExecution run calls perform no search, tuning, lowering, descriptor creation, general allocation/free, or reusable dense-RHS repacking.

Canonical Cellerator source, focused tests, Git state, and live SQLite coordination state are authoritative; Markdown and .ctxpp views are projections or read-only retrieval artifacts.
Volta sm_70 on CUDA 12.x is a product target. Do not require a toolchain migration that drops SM70 without user approval.
Use cuSPARSE for conventional CSR/BELL, cuBLASLt for ordinary dense work, CUB for data movement primitives, and custom CUDA only for CellPack structure vendor APIs cannot express.
